{{Quote|Gold One, White Four. I'm on a different outbound vector, away from Herkan Base. Should I move in to get Gold Three?''"<br />"''Negative, negative, Herkan Base's own personnel will do that. '''White Four''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of [[Taryn Zel]] at the [[New Jedi Order]]'s [[Operation Shieldfall|battle]] on [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]]. Zel [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] to support the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[StealthX wing]].<ref name="Conviction" />
